Компактный стартовый корабль для знакомс: A compact starter ship for learning flight, missions and outfitting. Low running costs help you try new activities without a large insurance risk.
Манёвренный малый истребитель с тремя ор: An agile small fighter with three weapon hardpoints. Careful range and power management are essential: its durability is limited.
Недорогой малый транспорт с небольшим ко: An inexpensive small transport with a compact hull and economical equipment. Suitable for early hauling and a lightweight exploration build, but not prolonged combat.
Малый многоцелевой корабль с дополнитель: A small multipurpose ship offering more options than starter hulls. Lets you try hauling, exploration and basic mining.
Небольшой скоростной боевой корабль. Хор: A small, fast combat ship. Well suited to learning bounty hunting and flying short combat sorties.
Более тяжёлый вариант Viper с дополнител: A heavier Viper variant with additional internal compartments. Offers more outfitting freedom at the expense of a light fighter’s agility.
Универсальный малый корабль с хорошим ба: A versatile small ship balancing hauling, mobility and combat capabilities. Useful as one hull for several early careers.
Вариант Cobra с увеличенным набором внут: A Cobra variant with more internal compartments and weaponry. Heavier and slower than the Mk III; purchase access depends on historical Horizons ownership conditions.
Современный малый представитель семейств: A modern small member of the Cobra family, designed for a wide range of tasks and SCO use. Combines a versatile layout with high mobility.
Средний грузовой корабль с доступом к ав: A medium cargo ship with access to outposts. Suitable for moving from small trading ships to regular cargo routes.

Современный средний грузовой транспорт с: A modern medium cargo transport with high capacity for its pad class. SCO support is useful on routes with long journeys within a system.
Крупный транспорт для больших партий тов: A large transport for bulk commodities and supplies. Its inertia and large-pad requirement call for advance route planning and cargo protection.
Усиленный родственник Type-9 с большим к: A reinforced relative of the Type-9 with many weapon and utility mounts. Suitable for heavy specialised builds, with mass and size to consider.
Небольшой пассажирский лайнер с доступом: A small passenger liner with access to small pads. Used for passenger missions and compact expedition builds.
Большой пассажирский корабль Saud Kruger: A large Saud Kruger passenger ship with good straight-line speed. Match passenger cabins and jump range to the specific mission type.
Крупный пассажирский лайнер с большим на: A large passenger liner with many internal compartments. Its size and pad restrictions matter when choosing docking stations.
Средний универсальный корабль, часто исп: A medium multipurpose ship often used for distant expeditions. Its internal compartments can accommodate a fuel scoop, scanner, repair equipment and an SRV hangar.
Более лёгкий и манёвренный представитель: A lighter, more agile member of the Asp family. Allows compact multipurpose builds without the commitments of a large hull.
Малый корабль для подвижных боевых и раз: A small ship for mobile combat and reconnaissance tasks. Its compact size makes finding surface landing sites easier.
Малый исследовательский корабль с хороше: A small exploration ship with good potential jump range. Allocate its limited internal compartments particularly carefully for a distant expedition.
Компактный боевой корабль с двумя крупны: A compact combat ship with two large weapon hardpoints. Power plant capacity and power distribution significantly affect weapon choices.
Быстрый крупный корабль Gutamaya для пер: A fast, large Gutamaya ship for hauling and specialised builds. It requires a large landing pad despite its relatively light hull.
Малый имперский корабль с выразительной: A small Imperial ship with a strong combat focus. Low mass and suitable equipment can produce a highly mobile build.
Имперский вариант малого истребителя Eag: An Imperial variant of the small Eagle fighter. Suitable for fast sorties where maintaining distance and protecting the light hull matter.
Средний федеральный корабль с прочным ко: A medium Federal ship with a durable hull and a range of internal compartments. More suited to protected specialised builds than lightweight agility.
Средний федеральный штурмовой корабль. Б: A medium Federal assault ship. Its combat potential depends on manoeuvrability, armour and coordinated weapon use.
Средний федеральный корабль с большим ко: A medium Federal ship with many weapon hardpoints. The power distributor, protection and mass management matter for sustained fire.
Крупный федеральный боевой корабль с дву: A large Federal combat ship with two huge weapon hardpoints. Requires a large pad and a substantial budget for equipment and rebuy.
Крупный имперский корабль с большим груз: A large Imperial ship with high cargo potential and strong protection. Inertia, outfitting cost and a large-pad requirement affect each trip’s practicality.
Средний универсальный корабль с вместите: A medium multipurpose ship with spacious internal compartments. Access to medium pads makes it convenient for trading, mining and hauling missions.
Боевой представитель семейства Python с: A combat member of the Python family with redesigned weaponry and SCO support. Its purpose differs from the classic Python’s cargo versatility.
Средний специализированный боевой корабл: A medium dedicated combat ship with a huge weapon hardpoint. Weapon selection must account for the power distributor and a mix of damage types.
Средний боевой корабль, делающий ставку: A medium combat ship focused on speed and heavy weaponry. Hardpoint geometry and range control matter when choosing tactics.
Большой универсальный корабль для экспед: A large multipurpose ship for expeditions, heavy hauling and combat builds. Its broad selection of internal compartments allows several tasks to be combined.
Современное развитие Anaconda с улучшенн: A modern development of the Anaconda with improved handling and FSD overcharge support. The large hull combines cargo, long-range and combat capabilities without changing ships.
Средний корабль семейства транспортов La: A medium ship in Lakon’s transport family with support for a fighter hangar. Allows cargo and support roles to be combined.
Средний многоцелевой корабль с сильным в: A medium multipurpose ship with strong weaponry and support for a fighter hangar. Used for combat, mining and general-purpose builds.
Облегчённый представитель семейства Krai: A lighter member of the Krait family without a fighter hangar. Suitable for mobile multipurpose tasks and exploration equipment.
Средний Alliance Chieftain рассчитан на: The medium Alliance Chieftain is designed for agile combat and a mix of weapon sizes. Protecting external modules and coordinating hardpoint fire are important.
Представитель семейства Alliance с возмо: A member of the Alliance family with support for a fighter. Weigh the additional support against mass and internal outfitting.
Более тяжёлый боевой представитель семей: A heavier combat member of the Alliance family. Allows a durable medium-sized weapons platform to be built.
Средний исследовательский корабль с подд: A medium exploration ship with SCO support and high potential jump range. Its layout is designed for convenient long journeys and operations near planets.
Средний корабль Gutamaya с вместительным: A medium Gutamaya ship with spacious compartments, cargo potential and SCO support. Suitable for several careers while retaining access to medium pads.
Крупный транспорт Zorgon Peterson для тя: A large Zorgon Peterson transport for heavy cargo trips. A large-pad requirement limits station choice; protection and rebuy costs belong in the route budget.
Средний специализированный добывающий ко: A medium dedicated mining ship based on the Type-8. The arrangement of mining equipment, refinery, limpets and cargo racks determines its working cycle.
Крупный исследовательский корабль Zorgon: A large Zorgon Peterson exploration ship with many internal compartments and support for new Mk II modules. Requires a large pad, but can carry varied expedition equipment.
